name: NBA 2K27 Shot Trainer
description: Standing Still, Off-Dribble and Fade-Away shot baselines with isolated shot-input Lua playback. Tap once to play the whole shot; live movement stays manual. Timing and tempo edits retain Run scripts. Requires Studio beta.42 or newer.

shots.label: Standing Still
shots.instructions: Stand still in your practice area and record one complete shot with the selected shot input.

shots.label: Off-Dribble
shots.instructions: Dribble manually into the shot and record the selected shot input. Movement and other controls remain live when you tap the assigned input to replay the shot.

shots.label: Fade-Away
shots.instructions: Move into your fade-away manually and record the selected shot input. Use the same movement and animation when you practice its one-tap shot playback.
